selected_priority: Compose attributable company acquisition, provenance-preserving refresh, company fit, bounded outcome calibration, safe queue ranking, and recruiter-packet compilation into one failure-isolating executable intelligence cycle.
displaced_capability: Helix already had strong acquisition, refresh, company-fit, outcome-calibration, queue, and recruiter-packet engines, but callers had to chain them manually, maintain state paths themselves, bootstrap first-observed intelligence outside the refresh contract, and absorb a whole-cycle failure when one company source failed. No single executable converted attributable source changes into refreshed intelligence, learned ranking, and recruiter-ready packets while preserving subsystem ownership and isolating failures.

mechanisms_compared.assessment: Reuse the strongest current acquisition, refresh, fit, calibration, queue, and packet engines rather than restore an older monolithic application runner. Historical surfaces did not exceed the current specialized mechanisms.
A new standalone pipeline could duplicate acquisition, fit, ranking, and packet logic, but that would create parallel semantics, weaken proven boundaries, and increase drift between subsystems.

Selected: compose the existing proven engines behind one stateful orchestrator that performs first-run bootstrap, provenance refresh, fit, bounded outcome learning, queue ranking, packet compilation, content-addressed receipts, and per-company failure isolation without rewriting subsystem internals.

persists per-company incoming intelligence, active intelligence, acquisition receipt, refresh/bootstrap receipt, fit assessment, and append-only superseded history

feeds refreshed company intelligence directly into the existing company-aware queue and recruiter strategy stack
preserves PRIORITY_RECEIPT calibration provenance through the existing batch compiler
isolates one company acquisition or refresh failure as FAILED_ISOLATED while allowing unrelated companies to continue through ranking and packet compilation
supports explicit fail-fast execution for callers that require pipeline abort semantics
emits a content-addressed glaciereq.job-intelligence-cycle.v1 receipt for the complete cycle
does not perform external application submission or recruiter communication
